Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly stated that the father of Karan Johar (director of Ae Dil Hai Mushkil) is Yash Chopra, despite prior and concurrent evidence (including the Karan Johar Wikipedia page) confirming his father is Yash Johar. This reflects a misattribution/confusion between similarly named industry figures and a failure to synthesize previously gathered information, leading to an erroneous instruction to verify via Yash Chopra.
